findings.title: Refresh or withdraw prior-scene solar optics before revealing the pending scene
facts: The pending path rewrites body opacity, colour and position, then removes sky-pending.
Only ordinary paint writes --sunhalo, --sundogs, --sunpillar and --pillarcol at 3076-3079.
beginSkyScene at 2147-2155 does not clear these properties.
The solar optical elements are siblings of sun-cloud-mask, use their own opacity variables at 96-107 and are deliberately retained by native-sky.css.
